headlines.summary: “The pope is Chiclayan!” chanted the crowd in his adopted home city. “Chiclayo is with you!”

headlines.title: Judge temporarily blocks Trump from moving ahead on Washington public golf course redevelopment
headlines.summary: A federal judge on Saturday ordered a two-week delay to any work at a historic Washington public golf course not far from the White House.

headlines.title: FAA ground stop disrupts college football
headlines.summary: Some college football games were delayed a few hours on Saturday or postponed to Sunday. And in Oklahoma at least, there will be perks for fans to make up for the inconvenience, including cheap beers.

headlines.title: Florida city cancels St. Patrick's Day parade, citing new anti-DEI law
headlines.summary: A new Florida law that prohibits taxpayer dollars from going toward diversity initiatives has prompted Delray Beach to cancel its St. Patrick's Day parade after a nearly 60-year run.

headlines.title: Maintenance gone awry caused nation-wide ground stop, says Transportation Secretary
headlines.summary: Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy points blame toward contractor in explaining Friday's nation-wide aviation ground stop.

headlines.title: US has lost measles elimination status, global health authorities say
headlines.summary: The U.S. has lost its status as a country where measles is eliminated, according to researchers with direct knowledge of the deliberations at the Pan American Health Organization.

headlines.title: US midterm election results trigger debate
headlines.summary: A majority of Americans support efforts to repeal tariffs of the US administration, a Reuters/Ipsos poll shows, as experts debate how far the incoming Democratic-controlled Congress can reshape trade policy and the US approach to China.

headlines.title: Europe weighs up US midterm power shift
headlines.summary: Many Europeans were relieved when the Republican Party lost control of both chambers of the United States Congress in the Nov 3 midterm elections, with the Democratic Party securing majorities in both the House of Representatives and the Senate.

headlines.title: Suspect dies after shooting north of White House
headlines.summary: WASHINGTON -- A shooting at a gym about 1.6 km north of the White House early Thursday left one person dead and four others injured. The suspected gunman later died, US media reported.

headlines.title: School bomb threats treated as hoaxes
headlines.summary: Bomb threats sent to thousands of schools across the United Kingdom, Ireland and Italy are being treated as hoaxes by police — the latest in a wave of hoaxes and disruptions that have hit Europe in recent weeks.

headlines.title: Guinea aims to turn iron ore wealth into industrial growth
headlines.summary: Guinea is seeking backing to convert its vast Simandou iron ore deposits into a driver of industrial growth, leveraging significant Chinese investment and international partnerships to expand infrastructure, develop local industries and create jobs beyond mineral exports.

headlines.title: President Murmu, PM Modi greet Jharkhand residents on State’s foundation day
headlines.summary: PM Modi congratulates Jharkhand on foundation day, praising its tribal pride, natural wealth, diverse culture, and developmental potential.

headlines.title: Depression to turn severe cyclonic storm over Bay of Bengal by November 17
headlines.summary: Depression over southeast Bay of Bengal is expected to intensify into a severe cyclonic storm by November 17, with rain and heavy winds affecting Tamil Nadu and nearby regions.

headlines.summary: Prince William and Princess Kate visit Mumbai November 16–18 for Earthshot Prize Summit, highlighting sustainability, transport, gully cricket, crafts, maternal care, and India's film industry.
